text.title: Google Performance Max Worked Example
text.summary: One end-to-end worked example showing the methodology applied to a realistic scenario, including the produced artefact, plus the asset group minimum-count table and the audience signal stack.

example.description: Faion lead-gen PMax: 95 conv/mo, 3 asset groups by audience theme, customer_match + remarketing signals, brand negatives on, Purchase weighted 1.0.
example.note: Floor met, 3 asset groups, signals attached, brand-cannibalization avoided.

section.title: Asset group requirements

list.item: HEADLINE: 5 required, max 30 chars each — distinct value props
DESCRIPTION: 4 required, max 90 chars each (include CTA)
Videos (YouTube): optional but strongly recommended for YouTube placements

section.note: Enum names are pinned to the API version in use (pin-api-version rule).

list.item: Audience signals are hints, not constraints — PMax can and will expand beyond them
Include: converting customer-match list, remarketing lists, similar audiences
Start broad, refine based on asset group performance labels after 4-6 weeks
